summary: The bounded record contains 1 compute-bound experiment and 0.0 minutes of elapsed time. This resolution is insufficient for causal or savings analysis.
bottlenecks_identified: Modification-time fallback collapsed the full execution into a 0.0-minute observation, so stage attribution is unavailable.
Neither source block identifies simultaneous model loads or runner dispatch, which prevents a concurrency audit.
improvements_suggested: Have the harness emit high-resolution monotonic timestamps for each execution stage.
Write task-linked GPU samples and worker process identifiers into every compute receipt.
Persist model count and runner identity, and select DualGPURunner only for 2-or-more-model parallel work.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Replace modification-time duration reconstruction with harness-owned monotonic timestamps.
Correlate accelerator samples and worker processes with the active task.
Add model count and chosen runner to the launch receipt.
meta_reflection: Object-table fetch-on-demand A/B ranks first because there is only 1 entry, not because a positive delay was measured. The immutable GPU-idle value is false, so the blocks do not support an idle-during-compute finding. No source row documents 2 or more simultaneous models, so DualGPURunner compliance cannot be judged.
